## Context

REQ-002 stood up an empty shell. This REQ adds the domain entities — Teacher, StudentGroup,
Student, VocabSet, Vocab, Card, ReviewLog — and their migrations.

## Requirement

Add the domain models and migrations, keeping py-fsrs out of the tree until REQ-005.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] All seven entities exist with their key fields and `owner` FKs; `makemigrations
      --check` is clean. *(Model test `test_entities_and_owner_fks`.)*
- [x] No FSRS import exists anywhere in the tree yet — a guard test `test_no_pyfsrs`
      asserts the library is absent until the scheduling boundary lands.
- [x] `Student` stores only a nickname and a hashed access code — no name, no email.

## Notes

- The `test_no_pyfsrs` guard flips to a boundary test in REQ-005 once py-fsrs legitimately
  enters the tree.
